translation: den I go bring you down ⟨את⟩ wit does wey dey go down inside di pit, to di people of ancient time, and I go make you siddon for di land down-below, like old-old ruins, ⟨את⟩ wit does wey dey go down inside di pit, so dat you no go dey live inside; and I go put brightness for di land of di living.
